active-learning.pseudocode:
def active_learning(labeled, pool, oracle, budget, k):
    model = train(labeled)
    while budget > 0 and pool:
        # 불확실성 샘플링: 예측 엔트로피가 큰 순
        scores = [entropy(model.predict_proba(x))
                  for x in pool]
        pick = top_k(pool, scores, min(k, budget))
        for x in pick:
            labeled.append((x, oracle(x)))  # 전문가 레이블링
            pool.remove(x)
        budget -= len(pick)
        model = train(labeled)  # 재학습
    return model
